name: Orkney Islands
title: Orkney —
tagline: Skara Brae, Maeshowe and the best-preserved Neolithic landscape in Europe.
summary: Orkney is a group of some 70 islands off the north coast of Scotland. The Heart of Neolithic Orkney, including Skara Brae, Maeshowe and the Ring of Brodgar, is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
The islands were ruled by Norse earls and became part of Scotland in 1472. Kirkwall's St Magnus Cathedral is a Norse-era masterpiece.
